title: Length bound for encoded dropped projections
statement: For every finite bit string $s$ and natural numbers $i,j$, take the total first and second projections of $s$, respectively, delete the first $i$ and $j$ bits from them, and encode the resulting pair. The encoded string has length at most $\max(|s|,2)$.
